dev.drainLife: Test: drain Burnt Land of life

chronicle.title: Island chronicle
chronicle.empty: Nothing worth telling has happened yet.
chronicle.start: The island wakes up. The Flying Spaghetti Monster watches with interest.

newSeason.1: Summer arrives: the sun bears down.
newSeason.3: Winter arrives: the cold creeps down from the peaks.

chronicle.reveal: The clouds part: the island grows to level {level}.

settled.duna: The dune has settled: the land has risen.

outcome.ignited: The embers set the dry vegetation alight.
outcome.springBurnt: The Burnt Land swallows the spring: no water rises.

biome.rockland: A rocky outcrop is laid bare.

chronicle.thaw: The thaw arrives: the rivers run high.

fire.lightningFire: Lightning sets the forest on fire!
fire.brasa: The embers set the vegetation on fire.
fire.dev: A fire breaks out on the island.
fire.out: The rain puts out the fire.
fire.burntLand: The wildfire leaves Burnt Land behind.
fire.remit: The Burnt Land recedes: life returns to its edges.
fire.drained: The Burnt Land is left lifeless.

deer.arrived: A herd of {count} deer arrives on the island.
deer.born: A fawn is born: {name}, calf of {mother}.
deer.herdSplit: A deer herd has split up: there were too many of them.
deer.hunger: The deer are starving: there isn't enough food for everyone.
deer.poisoned: {name} ate {food} and is paying for it.

lost.back: {name} got lost running, but made it back to the herd.
lost.rejected: Another herd chased {name} off with their antlers.
lost.alone: {name} got lost and is now on their own.

deer.stampede: Stampede! Something spooked a herd of deer.
deer.herdRun: The deer herd runs off together.
deer.herdRunSplit: The deer herd runs off; {count} break away from the group.
deer.leaving: A hungry herd of {count} deer leaves the island in search of grazing.
deer.left: The deer herd has left the island.

rabbit.arrived: A colony of {count} rabbits reaches the island.
rabbit.born: A kit is born: {name}, child of {mother}.
rabbit.twins: {mother} has had two kits. One is called {name}.
rabbit.litter: {mother} has had {count} kits. One is called {name}.

died.orphaned: {name} didn't make it without its mother.

rabbit.herdSplit: A rabbit colony has split up: the burrow wasn't big enough.
rabbit.hunger: The rabbits are going hungry: there isn't enough grass for so many.
rabbit.poisoned: {name} ate {food} and is paying for it.

lost.back: {name} spent the night out, but has made it back to the burrow.
lost.rejected: Another colony has chased {name} off with bites.
lost.alone: {name} got lost and is on its own now.

rabbit.stampede: Scatter! Something has spooked a rabbit colony.
rabbit.herdRun: The rabbit colony bolts for its burrow.
rabbit.herdRunSplit: The rabbit colony bolts; {count} lose their way.

burrow.dug: A rabbit colony has dug its burrow.
burrow.collapsed: A rabbit burrow has caved in!
burrow.blocked: Sand has blocked the entrance to a rabbit burrow.

rabbit.outbreak: {name} is the first to fall ill as a disease breaks out among the rabbits.
rabbit.dispersed: {name} leaves its colony to found its own.
rabbit.leaving: A starving colony of {count} rabbits abandons its burrow and moves on.
rabbit.left: The rabbit colony has left the island.

wolf.arrived: A pack of {count} wolves reaches the island.
wolf.born: A wolf pup is born: {name}, child of {mother}.
wolf.twins: {mother} has had two pups. One is called {name}.
wolf.litter: {mother} has had {count} pups in the den. One is called {name}.

died.orphaned: {name} didn't make it without its mother.

wolf.herdSplit: A wolf pack has split up: too many for one den.
wolf.hunger: The wolves are going hungry: there isn't enough prey.
wolf.poisoned: {name} ate {food} and is paying for it.

lost.back: {name} spent the night out, but has rejoined the pack.
lost.rejected: Another pack has chased {name} off with bites.
lost.alone: {name} got lost and now hunts alone.

wolf.stampede: Something has spooked a wolf pack!
wolf.herdRun: The wolf pack runs off together.
wolf.herdRunSplit: The wolf pack runs off; {count} break away.

burrow.dug: A wolf pack has built its den.
burrow.collapsed: A wolf den has caved in!
burrow.blocked: A wolf den has been covered up.

wolf.outbreak: A disease breaks out among the wolves. {name} is the first to fall ill.
wolf.dispersed: {name} leaves its pack to found its own.
wolf.repelled: {name} ({prey}) stood up to the wolves and they left.
wolf.trip: A wolf pack heads off to hunt far from its den.
wolf.leaving: A pack of {count} wolves, with nothing left to hunt, leaves the island.
wolf.left: The wolf pack has left the island. The prey breathe again.

crow.arrived: {count} ravens reach the island. They land, look around and take notes.
crow.born: A raven chick hatches: {name}, child of {mother}.
crow.twins: {mother} has raised two chicks. One is called {name}.
crow.litter: {mother} has {count} chicks in the nest. One is called {name}.

died.oldAge: {name} has died of old age. It knew everything.
died.fire: {name} didn't fly away from the fire in time.
died.orphaned: {name} didn't make it without its mother.

crow.herdSplit: A flock of ravens has split up: too many beaks for one nest.
crow.hunger: The ravens are going hungry: no carrion, nothing to steal.
crow.poisoned: {name} ate {food} and is paying for it.

lost.back: {name} spent the night out, but has rejoined the flock.
lost.alone: {name} got lost and now goes it alone.

crow.herdRun: The ravens take off all at once.
crow.herdRunSplit: The ravens take off; {count} go their own way.

burrow.dug: A pair of ravens has built a nest in a tree.
burrow.blocked: A raven nest has been covered up.

crow.outbreak: A disease breaks out among the ravens. {name} is the first to fall ill.
crow.dispersed: {name} leaves its flock to find a mate.
crow.howl: Cawing echoes across the island. Someone has found something.
crow.trip: The ravens head off to forage far from their nest.
crow.leaving: {count} ravens, with nothing to eat, leave the island.
crow.left: The ravens have left the island. Silence, at last.
crow.defended: {name} stood up to a {attacker} and killed it.

human.arrived: A band of {count} humans lands on the island. Nothing will ever be the same.
human.born: A human baby is born: {name}, child of {mother}.
human.twins: {mother} has had twins. One is called {name}.
human.litter: {mother} has had {count} babies. One is called {name}.

died.oldAge: {name} has died of old age, surrounded by family.
died.orphaned: {name} didn't make it without their mother.

human.herdSplit: A band of humans has split up: they didn't fit in the hut (or in the conversation).
human.hunger: The humans are going hungry: hunting and berries aren't enough for everyone.
human.poisoned: {name} ate {food} and is paying for it.

lost.back: {name} spent the night out, but has rejoined the band.
lost.rejected: Another band has chased {name} off with stones.
lost.alone: {name} got lost and now lives alone.

human.stampede: Something has spooked a band of humans!
human.herdRun: The band of humans runs off together.
human.herdRunSplit: The band of humans runs off; {count} break away.

burrow.dug: A band of humans has put up its hut.
burrow.blocked: A hut has been buried in sand.

human.outbreak: A disease breaks out among the humans. {name} is the first to fall ill.
human.dispersed: {name} leaves their band to found their own.
human.repelled: {name} ({prey}) stood up to the humans and they left.
human.howl: War cries echo across the island.
human.trip: A human hunting party heads away from its hut.
human.leaving: A band of {count} humans, with nothing to eat, packs up.
human.left: The humans have left the island. Nature breathes again (and doesn't trust it).
human.defended: The humans fought back: {name} has killed a {attacker}.

goblin.born: A goblin is born: {name}, child of {mother}. It already bites.
goblin.twins: {mother} has had two goblins. One is called {name}.
goblin.litter: {mother} has had {count} goblins in the nest. One is called {name}.

died.oldAge: {name} has died of old age (nobody knows how).
died.fire: {name} has burned. Not even fire wanted it.
died.orphaned: {name} didn't make it without its mother.
died.sun: {name} stayed out in the sun and withered away.
died.frost: The frost sealed the nest: {name} froze to death.
died.heat: {name} died of heat (which should be impossible).

goblin.herdSplit: A goblin band has split up. Loudly, of course.
goblin.hunger: The goblins are going hungry. Bad news for everyone else.
goblin.poisoned: {name} ate {food} and is paying for it.

lost.back: {name} got back to the nest before dawn.
lost.alone: {name} got lost and now hunts alone.

goblin.herdRunSplit: The goblins run off; {count} break away.

burrow.dug: The goblins have dug a nest in the Burnt Land.
burrow.collapsed: A goblin nest has caved in!
burrow.blocked: A goblin nest has been buried.

goblin.outbreak: A disease breaks out among the goblins. {name} is the first to fall ill.
goblin.dispersed: {name} leaves its band to dig its own nest.
goblin.repelled: {name} ({prey}) stood up to the goblins and they left.
goblin.howl: A goblin war cry tears through the night.
goblin.trip: The goblins go hunting far from their nest.
goblin.left: The goblins have left the island.
goblin.defended: {name} has killed a {attacker} that came for it.
goblin.burntBorn: Something stirs in the Burnt Land: {count} goblin nests have hatched.

balance.title: Balance
balance.hint: This is how the island is doing right now.
balance.empty: No animals have arrived yet. Once they do, you'll see how they're faring here.

mood.crowded: Too many for what there is

balance.back: They may come back by the shore.
balance.capHint: The black line is how many the island can feed.
balance.chartHint: One point every dawn. Circles are what the chronicle told.
balance.webHint: Bigger coin = more animals. Red arrow = that prey can't keep up.

decisions.title: Decisions
decisions.empty: No letters from the Flying Spaghetti Monster yet. It will write; it always does.

sands.title: Sands
sands.hint: Pick a sand and drag one finger over the island. Two fingers move the camera.

brasa.name: Ember
brasa.desc: Heat and ash. It can set dry plants alight.

duna.name: Dune
duna.desc: Lots of sand: raises the ground and diverts rivers.

humus.name: Humus
humus.desc: Fertile soil that holds water. Burns easily.

escarcha.name: Frost
escarcha.desc: Snow. Cools the area, freezes water and puts out fire.

despertar.name: Awakening
despertar.desc: Massless. Awakens the essence of life.

marea.name: Tide
marea.desc: Dissolves sediment: digs wells and canals. A trench works as a firebreak.

diary.born: I was born. Everything is huge and smells of grass.

poison.lethal: I ate {food}. I feel awful, truly awful.
poison.sick: Something in {food} didn't agree with me.
poison.confused: I ate {food}. I can see colours.

diary.ran: I ran until I couldn't feel my legs.
diary.split: I got separated from my herd mid-run. Where did they go?
diary.foundHerd: Found them! I'm acting like I was never lost.
diary.explore: Off for a wander. If anyone asks, I went out for cigarettes.
diary.regroup: It's getting late. Back to my lot; everything is scarier at night.
diary.fled: I ran without looking back. Fine, now I'm looking. Phew.
diary.nightAlone: Sleeping far from my herd tonight. I'll find them tomorrow. Every noise is a wolf.
diary.lostBack: I got lost, but I found my way back to my herd.
diary.alone: I'm lost. I'm alone and I talk to the trees.
diary.joinedGood: I joined another herd. They welcomed me.
diary.seekPack: I can smell others like me, far away. Going to find them: alone, you don't make it.
diary.searchPrey: Nothing to hunt around here. Off to look further away.
diary.fishing: Fish for dinner today. Heading to the water.
diary.fished: Caught a fish. Not much, but better than nothing.
diary.stalking: I can see the {prey}. Crouching, creeping closer, not a sound.
diary.keepAway: A {predator} too close. Backing off without taking my eyes off it.
diary.watching: There's a {predator} around. I stop eating and keep an eye on it.
diary.sawKill: They caught {name} right in front of us. We ran without looking back.
diary.callPack: I'm hungry. I called {name} and we're going after it together.
diary.shareKill: I've had enough. Making room for the hungrier ones.
diary.soloHunt: Slipping away from the pack for a bit. Going after a {prey} on my own.
diary.secretMeal: I caught {name} all by myself. Nobody in the pack knows.
diary.soloFled: It got away and I ran. Back to my pack like nothing happened.
diary.noRoom: There's not enough food for another pack on this island. Off to find territory elsewhere.
diary.joinedBad: Another herd chased me off with their antlers.
diary.rut: Autumn is here and {name} keeps looking at me funny.
diary.birth: My calf was born. Its name is {name}.
diary.dream: I dreamt I was a tree today. So peaceful.
diary.spaghetti: Why do I see spaghetti in the sky? And how do I know what spaghetti is?
diary.starving: I can't remember what grass tastes like.
diary.hungry: I'm so hungry I could eat a cactus.
diary.crowded: There are too many of us in this meadow. The good grass is gone.
diary.waterFar: No river nearby… but maybe there's squirrel pee.
diary.lonely: Still alone. The trees don't talk back.
diary.old: My knees creak when I get up.
diary.thirsty: My tongue feels like an old shoe.
diary.parched: I'd give my antlers for a puddle.
diary.arrived: I've arrived on the island. It smells of fresh grass and a hint of pasta.

scare.fire: Fire! I ran without looking back.
scare.sandFall: It rained sand from the sky. I hate this place.
scare.dig: The ground opened under my hooves. That's not normal.
scare.spring: Water burst out of the ground! I nearly fainted.
scare.heat: Something is burning the ground around here. I'll keep away.
scare.frost: The meadow froze all of a sudden. My hooves are icicles.
scare.glow: Something is glowing over there. A bit scary… and I really want to look.
scare.lightning: Lightning! I ran without knowing where.
scare.thunder: Another thunderclap. My fur is standing on end.
scare.corpse: I saw one of us lying on the ground. I walked away.

diary.used: The same thing again. I don't even flinch any more.

curious.spring: I went to see the new water. Nice and cool.
curious.glow: I went to see what was glowing. No idea what it is, but it's pretty.

diary.buried: Sand fell on top of me. Everything hurts.
diary.struck: Lightning struck right next to me. My ears are still ringing.
diary.grief: I won't leave {name}. They aren't moving.
diary.storm: Nobody can sleep with this thunder.
diary.stormShelter: We've gone under the trees to wait out the storm.
diary.rain: I took shelter under a tree. Rain puts me in a bad mood.
diary.siesta: Too hot to do anything. Siesta in the shade.
diary.digging: I got stuck with the digging. The others watch and give opinions.
diary.newHome: We found an empty burrow. It smells of strangers, but it's ours now.
diary.mated: {name} and I... well, you know how rabbits are.
diary.litter: {count} kits! I named one {name}. I'll get to the rest.
diary.rainHome: It's raining. Off to the burrow; I'm not a duck.
diary.sunbathe: Came out to sunbathe by the entrance for a bit. On guard, of course.
diary.flood: Water in the burrow! I paddled out as best I could.
diary.dugOut: Someone blocked our entrance. I dug until I saw the sky.
diary.blocked: Something blocked the burrow entrance. It's pitch dark in here.
diary.collapse: Our burrow caved in on us. I got out by a whisker.
diary.sick: My eyes are swollen and I don't even fancy clover.
diary.recovered: I got over the disease. I'm practically indestructible now.
diary.leaveHome: I'm all grown up. Off to find a burrow of my own.
diary.sawPredator: A {predator}! I saw it in the grass.
diary.gaveUp: It got away. It runs faster than my patience.
diary.standGround: I stood my ground and showed my antlers. Come and have a go.
diary.kicked: Got kicked so hard I saw stars.
diary.gorged: I've eaten until I can't move. I'll lie down for two days.
diary.carryMeat: Taking a chunk back to the pups. It's heavier than it looks.
diary.feedPups: The pups have eaten. Not even a thank you.
diary.relay: I took the meat over from {name}. They were dragging their paws.
diary.howl: Awoooooo. (Translation: we're here and there are lots of us.)
diary.trip: There's nothing left to hunt here. We're off for a few days.
diary.tripBack: Heading home. It smells like us.
diary.leaving: Nothing left here. We're off to find another island.
diary.stole: I stole a piece from whoever caught it. They do the work; I do the digesting.
diary.revisit: Back where there was meat last time. Memory is a wonderful thing.
diary.sunburnt: The sun! It burns my skin! Who turned that on?
diary.frozenIn: The frost has sealed my nest. It's deadly cold in here. Literally.
diary.killedAttacker: It came for us and it didn't go home.
diary.escaped: It caught me, but I broke free. I'm bleeding a bit, but I'm still here.
diary.feedYoung: I brought {name} some food. Pre-chewed, but food.
diary.freezing: I'm so cold I can't feel my legs anymore.
diary.overheated: I'm roasting. I need some shade or I'll melt.
diary.hibernating: Zzz… (Hibernating. Nobody wake me until spring.)

cause.orphaned: Didn't make it without its mother.
